subject: ইংরেজি লিখিত
topic: Appropriate Prepositions মেগা ব্যাংক (৫০টি অতি কমন বাক্য)
question:
বিগত বিসিএস ও মন্ত্রণালয়ের পরীক্ষায় বারবার আসা নিচের ৫০টি বাক্যের শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক Appropriate Preposition বসান:
(1) He is good ____ English.
(2) She is proud ____ her talent.
(3) Smoking is injurious ____ health.
(4) We should abide ____ organizational rules.
(5) He was accused ____ theft.
(6) Do not look down ____ the poor.
(7) He prefers milk ____ tea.
(8) He is senior ____ me by three years.
(9) She is junior ____ him in service.
(10) Divide the sweets ____ the two children.
(11) Distribute the relief ____ the villagers.
(12) The man died ____ cancer.
(13) He died ____ over-eating.
(14) The patriot died ____ his country.
(15) He died ____ an accident.
(16) Do not boast ____ your wealth.
(17) He is addicted ____ gambling.
(18) You should abstain ____ smoking.
(19) He is blind ____ his son's faults.
(20) The man is blind ____ one eye.
(21) I agree ____ you on this point.
(22) He agreed ____ my proposal.
(23) He deal ____ rice.
(24) He knows how to deal ____ customers.
(25) Water consists ____ hydrogen and oxygen.
(26) Happiness consists ____ contentment.
(27) Congratulate him ____ his success.
(28) I am confident ____ success.
(29) He is devoid ____ common sense.
(30) He was deprived ____ his rights.
(31) He is eligible ____ the post.
(32) The boy is fond ____ sweets.
(33) The room is full ____ smoke.
(34) He was found guilty ____ murder.
(35) Hard work is key ____ success.
(36) Lack ____ money stopped the work.
(37) Listen ____ your teachers.
(38) Look ____ the baby in my absence.
(39) She was married ____ a doctor.
(40) He insisted ____ my going there.
(41) Rely ____ your own ability.
(42) He is superior ____ me.
(43) He suffered ____ fever.
(44) Take care ____ your health.
(45) He prevented me ____ going there.
(46) The train arrived ____ Dhaka station.
(47) What is the time ____ your watch?
(48) He is tired ____ walking.
(49) He is true ____ his word.
(50) Yield not ____ temptation.
answer:
1. at (good at = দক্ষ)
2. of (proud of = গর্বিত)
3. to (injurious to = ক্ষতিকর)
4. by (abide by = মেনে চলা)
5. of (accused of = অভিযুক্ত)
6. upon / on (look down upon = ঘৃণা করা)
7. to (prefer ... to = অধিক পছন্দ করা)
8. to (senior to = জ্যেষ্ঠ)
9. to (junior to = কনিষ্ঠ)
10. between (দুইজনের মধ্যে between)
11. among (অনেকের মধ্যে among)
12. of (রোগে মারা গেলে die of)
13. from (অতিরিক্ত কোনো কারণে die from)
14. for (দেশের জন্য আত্মত্যাগ die for)
15. by (দুর্ঘটনায় মারা গেলে die by)
16. of (boast of = অহংকার করা)
17. to (addicted to = কুপথে আসক্ত)
18. from (abstain from = বিরত থাকা)
19. to (দোষের প্রতি অন্ধ blind to)
20. of (চোখে অন্ধ blind of)
21. with (ব্যক্তির সাথে একমত agree with)
22. to (প্রস্তাবে একমত agree to)
23. in (ব্যবসা করা deal in)
24. with (আচরণ করা deal with)
25. of (গঠিত consist of)
26. in (নিহিত consist in)
27. on (অভিনন্দন congratulate on)
28. of (আত্মবিশ্বাসী confident of)
29. of (বর্জিত devoid of)
30. of (বঞ্চিত deprived of)
31. for (যোগ্য eligible for)
32. of (পছন্দ fond of)
33. of (পরিপূর্ণ full of)
34. of (দোষী guilty of)
35. to (চাবিকাঠি key to)
36. of (অভাব lack of)
37. to (মনোযোগ দিয়ে শোনা listen to)
38. after (দেখাশোনা করা look after)
39. to (বিবাহিতা married to)
40. on (জিদ ধরা insist on)
41. on / upon (নির্ভর করা rely on)
42. to (উচ্চতর superior to)
43. from (ভোগা suffer from)
44. of (যত্ন নেওয়া care of)
45. from (বাধা দেওয়া prevent from)
46. at (নির্দিষ্ট স্টেশনে arrived at)
47. by (ঘড়ির সময় by your watch)
48. of (ক্লান্ত tired of)
49. to (অটল true to)
50. to (নতি স্বীকার yield to)
tips: Die of (রোগে), Die by (দুর্ঘটনায়), Die for (দেশের তরে), Die from (অতিরিক্ত খাওয়া বা ক্ষত) — এই ৪টি নিয়ম মুখস্থ রাখুন।
